reason: node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA signature-verification flaw; no patched release is available as of 2026-10-02. Present only in word-addin devDependencies through office-addin-dev-certs -> mkcert and office-addin-debugging -> @microsoft/teamsfx-core. Their local certificate helpers generate/sign certificates and parse local key/certificate files; they do not call the vulnerable signature verifier. The production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs, not these development dependencies. REMOVE WHEN: node-forge publishes a patched release and these chains can resolve it; reassess if the dependency gains a production or signature-verification caller.

braces <=3.0.3 recursive AST stack exhaustion; no patched npm release is available as of 2026-10-06 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). Locked only as a devDependency: frontend eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob and @ladle/react -> globby -> fast-glob; word-addin webpack-dev-server -> http-proxy-middleware -> micromatch.
